sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Three separate statue-restoration events, completable in any order. Finishing all three spawns a chest and opens the path to Dhuum.

sections.heading: The three statues
bullets: Statue of Ice — fight the Broken King under a strict 3:30 time limit.
Statue of Death & Resurrection — collect spirit energy; a progress-tracked event, not a burst check.
Statue of Darkness — grab a light orb, then defeat two bosses: Eye of Judgment and Eye of Fate.

sections.heading: Hazards
bullets: Expect Eaters of Souls, Light Thieves, Minotaurs, Twisted Spirits, and Spirit Hordes spawning throughout — these aren't just flavor, they can overwhelm an unprepared squad.
If going for the 5-minute achievement across all three, split the squad efficiently up front rather than finishing one before starting the next.
